# Library
```{r}
library(readr)
library(dplyr)
library(purrr)
library(sjPlot)
library(performance)
source("../utility_fun.R")
```

# Read discovery (abcd_gr1) and testing (abcd_gr2) data
```{r}
abcd_gr1 <- read_rds("../outputs/abcd_gr1.rds")
abcd_gr2 <- read_rds("../outputs/abcd_gr2.rds")
```

# Sensitivity analysis: P-threshold = 0.05 # Only dichotomize Likert variables like in the main analysis
```{r}
vars <- readRDS("../outputs/vars_98.rds")
exwas_headache_1 <- exwas(data_train = abcd_gr1, vars = vars, outcome = "medhx_2q_l", data_test = abcd_gr2, conf_int = 0.95, p_cutoff = 0.05)

sig_vars_1 <- exwas_headache_1$univariate_models_sig # has 1 Likert variable tbi_ss_worst_overall_l

# Dichotomize 1 Likert variable tbi_ss_worst_overall_l as changing from 0.1 to 0.05
vars[vars == "tbi_ss_worst_overall_l"] <- "tbi_worst_overall"
# Significant (p-value <= 0.05)
exwas_headache_2 <- exwas(data_train = abcd_gr1, vars = vars, outcome = "medhx_2q_l", data_test = abcd_gr2, conf_int = 0.95, p_cutoff = 0.05)

abcd_gr2_weight_sens2 <- exwas_headache_2$data_test_exposome
```

```{r}
# eTable 5
mod1.2 <- glmer(medhx_2q_l ~ (1 | site_id_l_br/rel_family_id/src_subject_id) + 
                 age_years + sex_br + race_black + race_white + ethnicity_hisp,
              nAGQ = 0, family = binomial, data = abcd_gr2_weight_sens2) # all population

mod2.2 <- glmer(medhx_2q_l ~ weighted_exposome + (1 | site_id_l_br/rel_family_id/src_subject_id) + 
                 age_years + sex_br + race_black + race_white + ethnicity_hisp, 
              nAGQ = 0, family = binomial, data = abcd_gr2_weight_sens2) # all population

com2 <- tab_model(mod1.2, mod2.2, digits.rsq = 4, digits = 3)

# Nagelkerke’s R2
r2(mod1.2)[2]
r2(mod2.2)[2]

anova(mod1.2, mod2.2, test="Chisq")

# R2
r2(mod1.2)[2]
r2(mod2.2)[2]

anova(mod1.2, mod2.2, test="Chisq")

# Cross validation
AUC <- function(y, yhat) pROC::roc(y~yhat, direction = "<")$auc

clusterVariables <- c("site_id_l_br", "rel_family_id", "src_subject_id")

cv_mod1.2 <- cv(mod1.2, k = 10, clusterVariables = clusterVariables, criterion = AUC, seed = 724, ncores = 3)
cv_mod2.2 <- cv(mod2.2, k = 10, clusterVariables = clusterVariables, criterion = AUC, seed = 724, ncores = 3)

# Export results
## Number of clusters
cv_mod_sens <- list(cv_mod1.2, cv_mod2.2)
get_n_clusters(cv_mod_sens) # May not need # Will remove at the end (remove the function get_n_clusters in utility_fun)

## Coefficients
get_cv_ORs(cv_mod_sens) %>% View()

# Get AUC
get_criteria(cv_mod_sens)$criterion_by_fold %>% View()
get_criteria(cv_mod_sens)$criterion_average %>% View()
```
